asks: Are you going through, or are you looking at yourself?
Did somebody come through just before you?
Can you swim? It isn't important. I'm asking.
description: Where the door was there's a pane of water held upright in the frame, unsupported, its surface trembling slightly. The room on the far side of it's visible and about a second behind.
emotes: Rings run out across {it} from a point about head height.
{it} bulges towards the room and settles flat again.
The room reflected in {it} does something the room doesn't do.
looks: The surface shivers in rings when anybody in the room speaks, including you.
Your reflection in it's doing what you're doing, with a delay you can just about measure.
A drip is forming at the bottom edge. It has been forming for a while and it isn't going to fall.
name: a standing sheet of water
says: You can come through. You'll be wet on the other side, briefly.
Everything that has gone through me is still in me somewhere.
Speak up. It makes a nice pattern.
